target.title: fix(infra): cap session-maintenance-warning dedupe cache with LRU eviction
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in session maintenance warning deduplication. The `warnedContexts` Map accumulated every warned session key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap. A long-running gateway process would retain entries indefinitely — 4 106 sessions warned means 4 106 entries, forever.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a 4 096-entry LRU cache with touch-on-read. Oldest untouched entries are evicted on overflow; frequently re-warned sessions are promoted to MRU on access. The same-key update path replaces the value in-place without evicting other entries. The public `deliverSessionMaintenanceWarning` API is unchanged — only caller (`src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts:1004`) needs no modification.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct warned sessions. Gateways exceeding the cap may see one extra warning per evicted entry — a bounded trade-off versus the prior unbounded memory growth.

## Evidence

### Runtime proof: production `setWarnedContext` with LRU cap

Imports the real `src/infra/session-maintenance-warning.ts` module through its testing surface and exercises the production `setWarnedContext` / `getWarnedContext` helpers:

```text
$ NODE_ENV=development npx tsx outputs/issue-101643/live-proof.ts

=== Real runtime proof: session-maintenance-warning LRU cache cap ===

Production constant MAX_WARNED_CONTEXTS = 4096

--- Phase 1: Unbounded Map (simulated pre-fix) ---
  4106 entries → Map.size = 4106 (grows without bound)
  Problem: long-running gateway retains every warned session forever

--- Phase 2: Production setWarnedContext with LRU cap ---
  Filled 4096 entries via production setWarnedContext()
  Touched session:0 (MRU promotion — survives eviction)
  Inserted overflow entry — evicts oldest untouched (session:1)
  Re-inserted evicted session:1 — cache still bounded at MAX

--- Phase 3: Invariant checks ---
  ✓ Cache bounded at MAX entries (production setWarnedContext cap works)
  ✓ LRU-touched entries survive overflow (session:0 was touched, preserved)
  ✓ Oldest untouched evicted on overflow
  ✓ Re-insert after eviction stays within cap

--- Phase 4: Same-key update (no eviction side-effect) ---
  Updated test-key in-place — value changed, no unrelated eviction

=== All production LRU cache invariants verified ===
Module: src/infra/session-maintenance-warning.ts
Cache cap: setWarnedContext enforces MAX_WARNED_CONTEXTS (4096)
Touch-on-read: getWarnedContext promotes to MRU
Caller: src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts:1004 (no changes needed)
```

### Focused test run (16/16, includes new LRU eviction test)

```text
$ pnpm test src/infra/session-maintenance-warning.test.ts -- --run

 ✓ |infra| ... > forwards session context to outbound delivery
 ✓ |infra| ... > suppresses duplicate warning contexts for the same session
 ✓ |infra| ... > falls back to a system event when the last target is not deliverable
 ✓ |infra| ... > skips warning delivery in test mode
 ✓ |infra| ... > enqueues a system event when outbound delivery fails
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration rolls over 59500ms to next unit instead of 60 seconds
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration rolls over 3570000ms to next unit instead of 60 minutes
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration rolls over 86370000ms to next unit instead of 24 hours
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration keeps 30000ms in its own unit as 30 seconds
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration keeps 89500ms in its own unit as 1 minute
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration keeps 1800000ms in its own unit as 30 minutes
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration keeps 5370000ms in its own unit as 1 hour
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration keeps 43200000ms in its own unit as 12 hours
 ✓ |infra| ... > formatDuration keeps 129570000ms in its own unit as 1 day
 ✓ |infra| ... > evicts the least-recently-used context entry once the cache exceeds its cap
 ✓ |infra| ... > re-delivers when the warning context changes for the same session

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```
